causal_chain: PodChaos pod_kill deletes one pod of demo-target in kubeheal-system
ReplicaSet detects missing pod and creates a replacement pod
Replacement pod starts and registers endpoints
In-flight requests to killed pod fail until replacement is ready
17676bd0ecc1445fca5d77cb3f78640bac3d0f9f.rationale: Restarting the deployment clears failed endpoints and restores stable service after pod kill induced transient failures.

causal_chain: PodChaos pod_kill deletes one pod of kubeheal-system/demo-target
In-flight requests to the killed pod fail immediately
Endpoints list briefly missing one address causes connection errors
New pod becomes ready and endpoints are repopulated
453cec9a4741e2e40924dda9246e8af61211bb80.rationale: Restarting the deployment clears failed endpoints and resolves connection errors caused by the pod kill, as confirmed by past incident success and medium risk level.

catalog_entry.category_rationale: the failure is local but propagates to every caller for the duration of the restart, which is the defining property of a cascade rather than an isolated fault.
catalog_entry.description: One pod disappears without warning. In-flight requests on that pod fail immediately, the ReplicaSet schedules a replacement, and callers see a short burst of connection errors followed by recovery once the new pod is ready and endpoints are repopulated.
catalog_entry.mechanism: `PodChaos{action: pod-kill}` deletes the selected pod(s); the ReplicaSet recreates them.
typical_symptoms: connection refused or reset from a single endpoint
HTTP 502/503 spikes while the replacement starts
endpoints list briefly missing one address
